purpose: Move fixed-carrier twine crossover inward and support the eyes on one common shelf, clear of both actuator positions and cap removal.

geometry.note: The new side eye moves 8 mm toward +X to keep the near-side approach clear of the shaft. This is not a uniform reduction in all bounding-box dimensions.
geometry.support: Upper and lower shelves joined by two 4 mm ribs flanking an open rope passage.

checks.scope: Static cord segments against assembled rigid parts, phone and stock neck; carrier against all other rigid parts including clamp fasteners. Combined parent checks cover service and motion.
checks.note: All eight configurations passed again after the final upper-shelf and 4 mm rib completion. Combined parent service and motion checks remain separately authoritative.

assembly: Thread shaft-side fixed eye and transverse fixed eye, then the actuator lower guide and upper guide to the rocker tie eye. Large rotated-phone example wraps the positive-Y edge of the lower actuator eye; other samples use its negative-Y edge. No pulley, extra printed part or hardware.
limits: Segmented rope path is an illustrative clearance envelope, not a friction/contact solution.
Actual twine diameter, bend friction, abrasion and slack retention remain unvalidated.
